METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

4. When learning Introduction to Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Metalwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Metalwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Metalwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Metalwork.

5. When learning Safety in the workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the workshop.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the workshop.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the workshop.

6. When learning Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .

7. When learning Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria.

8. When learning Measuring and marking out tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and marking out tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and marking out tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and marking out tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and marking out tools.

9. When learning Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.

10. When learning Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.

11. When learning Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

12. When learning Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
